item.title: ‘Descendants’ Universe Expanding With Disney’s New Sidekick Spin-Off Film ‘Hidden Heroes: A Descendants Story’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest update from the world of Disney! We've got some exciting news for fans of the Descendants franchise. Get ready for a new chapter in the cinematic universe: Hidden Heroes: A Descendants Story.
[Cut to music clip from Descendants]
Host: "This new music-packed film shifts the spotlight to a new generation of characters - the descendants of Disney's iconic sidekicks. The story follows a group of aspiring sidekicks training at the secretive Sidekick Academy, as they try to protect the fairytale world from a villainous pair. Leading the cast are Dior Goodjohn, Momona Tamada, Jacob Rodriguez, and more, playing the children of beloved Disney characters like Genie, Yzma, and Lumière.
[Cut to soundbite from Ayo Davis, president of Disney Kids & Family]
Ayo Davis: "One of the things that has always made Descendants so special is the way it invites audiences to experience familiar Disney stories through an entirely new perspective. With Hidden Heroes, we're finally putting the sidekicks center stage..."
Host: "This announcement comes on the heels of the huge success of Descendants: Wicked Wonderland, which became the No. 1 movie on Disney+ globally during its first 10 days of release. The film's soundtrack also debuted at No. 1 on Billboard's Kid Albums chart and remains on the Soundtracks chart two weeks later. And if you're eager for more, don't miss the Disney's Worlds Collide concert tour, returning this fall with a 60-date North American, U.K. and European run.
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in to this special update from the world of Disney. We can't wait to see what's in store for Hidden Heroes: A Descendants Story. Stay tuned for more updates, and we'll catch you on the next episode!"
